brief:
A new documentary featuring testimonies from Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers refutes longstanding talking points used to defend Israel's military operations, according to The Guardian. The film draws on firsthand accounts from military personnel to challenge narratives that have circulated throughout the conflict.

The project, referenced as NAZA, compiles statements from Israeli service members whose accounts contradict claims frequently made by Israel's supporters in public debate. The testimonies span years of allegations characterized as baseless propaganda in defense of military conduct.
dek: The film’s testimonies from Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers expose years of baseless propaganda.
title: Film featuring Israeli soldiers debunks propaganda claims about Gaza war
